scope: Manually reviewed primary repository pages. Metadata review is separate from native acquisition, full paper review and real hardware validation. Missing fields remain unverified.

datasets.paper: Pradhan, He and Jiang, Multi-day dataset of forearm and wrist electromyogram for hand gesture recognition and biometrics, Scientific Data 9, 733 (2022).
datasets.paper_review: Publisher-linked citation; paper retrieval failed this review.
datasets.layout: Official metadata assigns F1-F8 to columns1-8 and forearm ring1, F9-F16 to columns9-16 and ring2; unused columns17/24/25/32. Existing672-record subset headers and signal checksums are verified. Circumferential direction and our device wiring remain unverified; no differential-pair transformation assumed.
limitations: Public stored-column identity does not authenticate our device wiring, arm or direction.
Full paper retrieval remains unavailable; this is official repository metadata plus native subset evidence.

datasets.paper: Open Access Dataset, Toolbox and Benchmark Processing Results of High-Density Surface Electromyogram Recordings; DOI 10.1109/TNSRE.2021.3082551.
datasets.paper_review: Publisher-linked citation; equipment geometry not independently reviewed.
datasets.layout: High-density array; not an eight-channel circumferential device.
limitations: PR gesture task and four synchronous force subtasks are distinct; no force trajectory inferred for PR.
No new raw download or native experiment in this review.

datasets.paper: Pizzolato et al., Comparison of six electromyography acquisition setups on hand movement classification tasks (2017).
datasets.paper_review: Article title, public-data statement and official acquisition guidelines read; not exhaustive full-paper validation.
datasets.layout: Two eight-channel Myo rings; second tilted 22.5 degrees clockwise. Acceleration from first Myo.
limitations: Acceleration does not establish synchronized gyro, raw units or guided body-frame calibration.
Paper's DB5 data DOI resolves to dataset 4; corrected author record 1000116 independently confirms DB5 identity and license.
Official subject ZIP links are visible; native download access was not tested.

datasets.paper: Palermo et al., Analysis of the repeatability of grasp recognition for hand robotic prosthesis control based on sEMG data, ICORR (2017).
datasets.paper_review: Author's six-page paper retrieved; acquisition/synchronization/analysis paragraphs extracted and pages 2/3 visually reviewed. Reported experiments not reproduced.
datasets.layout: Eight Trigno sensors in proximal ring, six below; two EMG columns and six acceleration columns empty according to official variables.
limitations: Acceleration is sampled at 148.148 Hz then interpolated to 2000 Hz; aligned export rows are not native IMU rate.
No synchronized gyro confirmed; do not infer full six-axis eligibility from inertial modality label.
Official preprocessed ZIP links visible; raw data and acquisition access not tested.

datasets.paper_review: Author repository and README reviewed; linked full paper not reviewed.
datasets.layout: Four Trigno Quattro sensors, two staggered rows of eight; first row starts at extensor carpi ulnaris.
limitations: Recording starts after position and grasp formation to avoid transitions; not automatic onset/offset ground truth.
Nine-position grid described, five positions acquired; do not invent nine acquired conditions.
README repeats day1block2 in its four-folder listing; native names must be inspected.

datasets.paper: Miljkovic and Isakovic, Effect of the sEMG electrode (re) placement and feature set size on the hand movement recognition; DOI 10.1016/j.bspc.2020.102292.
datasets.paper_review: Publisher-linked citation; paper retrieval failed this review.
datasets.layout: CH1 through CH8; detailed assembly/position referred to linked paper and not verified here.
limitations: Record describes at least ten repetitions but no sample-level repetition boundaries supplied in eight-column files.
Some analysis repetitions discarded; cannot reconstruct segmentation from count alone.

datasets.paper: ReactEMG: Stable, Low-Latency Intent Detection from sEMG via Masked Modeling; arXiv 2506.19815.
datasets.paper_review: arXiv v6 selected inference, datasets, training, metrics and limitations sections reviewed; full model results not reproduced.
limitations: Code license does not prove hosted mixed data-archive license.
Use existing native ROAM static subset audit for channel/rate; do not infer properties from model generalization claims.
ROAM three-class task excludes pinch;50-sample smoothing uses future data (.25s at200Hz). Native112-static-record audit does not cover all published tasks.
